title: QR Code Attendance System
summary: An attendance workflow used by an organization handling 1,600+ students.
problem: Turn attendance collection into a practical QR-based workflow.
story: QR scanning connects attendance tracking with Google services. The published portfolio reports use by an organization handling more than 1,600 students. This describes the organization’s scale; active usage and time savings have not been measured here.

title: TANAW
summary: A cross-platform mobile experience with a focus on usable, responsive interfaces.
problem: Bring a consistent product experience to mobile devices.
story: The application combines mobile interfaces with backend services. This case study documents the product and implementation; adoption figures and a detailed breakdown of individual responsibilities are not yet published.

title: CyberAdryx Online
summary: Cybersecurity learning content for IT students and professionals.
problem: Make cybersecurity information approachable and useful to learners.
story: An educational website presents cybersecurity insights alongside a map-based experience, encouraging practical learning and responsible cyber practices.

title: Healthmate
summary: Health records, patient information, and ingredient-based nutrition discovery.
problem: Organize health information into useful workflows.
story: A web application brings patient records and nutrition discovery into one experience. Presented as project work; production adoption is not claimed.

title: Library Management System
summary: A structured approach to organizing and retrieving library data.
problem: Explore reliable record management and data organization.
story: Project work covering data modeling, querying, encryption, and optimization. Its value is demonstrated through the application workflow rather than unverified commercial outcomes.

title: Personal Portfolio
summary: A personal home for selected work, experience, and professional conversations.
problem: Help people understand the person behind the work.
story: The original portfolio established the warm palette, expressive typography, and personal details carried into this new site.

title: Powerfitness
summary: A gym website bringing schedules, trainers, and membership information together.
problem: Help prospective members find practical gym information.
story: A responsive website presents classes, trainer profiles, membership highlights, and a contact experience.

title: Memorial Plan Manager
summary: Plan records, cost calculations, and printable receipts in a desktop workflow.
problem: Bring related administrative tasks into one application.
story: A desktop project supports creating, viewing, updating, and deleting plans, calculating totals, and printing receipts.

title: Java Calculator
summary: An expression calculator supporting more than basic arithmetic.
problem: Translate mathematical expressions into dependable application behavior.
story: A learning project covering expression parsing, parentheses, negatives, decimals, and exponents.
